title: MBD-to-Digital-Twin Deployment Framework for Autonomous Miyun Reservoir Operation

history.key_changes: Initialized WHM-2 with CHS-consistent formulation, seven-layer MBD deployment chain, digital-twin xIL verification path, and four-gate governance skeleton for Miyun Reservoir.
Added explicit ODD envelope and deterministic violation policy, immutable artifact package for shift traceability, and SCADA pre-activation checklist with role-bound accountability.
Added bounded contribution statement, explicit transferability prerequisites/non-transfer conditions, and cross-audience communication guardrail aligned with ODD-bounded reversible autonomy.

Formalized deployment authorization predicate (Eq.4), added freshness-constrained effective gates (Eq.5), and added effective-gate implication to AuthReady with governance-only non-interference statement (Eq.6).

Added rollback SLO implication for shift execution (Eq.7), alarm triage linkage to authority states, and multi-shift handover continuity artifact requirements with non-compensability of missing evidence.
Added bounded cross-site reporting tuple (Eq.8), mandatory negative-transfer blocker registry, and WSAL external-messaging lock tied to ODD and downgrade evidence.
Added scenario-complete gate satisfiability (Eq.9), explicit non-compensability governance axiom, and traceability-preserving xIL evidence update rule (Eq.10).
Added shift-ready admissibility predicate (Eq.11), latency-bounded command validity with HOLD freeze rule (Eq.12), and mandatory shift closure record gating next-shift promotion.
Added CHS interoperability tuple (Eq.13), disclosure parity rule for external communication, and minimal reusable package schema for downstream engineering transfer.
Added submission-ready implication predicate (Eq.14), monotonic invalidation rule under post-validation drift (Eq.15), and proof-carrying release-note minimum for valid submission claims.
Added pre-submission operability audit gate (Eq.16), bounded high-priority alarm backlog freeze rule (Eq.17), and rollback drill recency/environment constraints for audit validity.

Added public-claim traceability token (Eq.18), cross-audience consistency subset rule tied to audit-passed claims (Eq.19), and mandatory uncertainty/fallback co-disclosure fields for external benefit reporting.
Added completion predicate aligned with CHS exit condition (Eq.20), non-shortcut rule forbidding pre-threshold completion (Eq.21), and minimum completion evidence bundle schema.
